text:
liz_marketing: Quick heads-up — funnel dash shows a big registration bump from last week's webinar but MQLs didn't move. Anyone see routing/dup issue?

tom_growth: Noted. Which cohort/time window? Link to chart: https://rbw.in/s/abc123 :mag_right:

maria_analytics: Looking — pulling raw counts now. SQL I ran quickly:
```
SELECT source, count(*)
FROM leads
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY source;
```

noah_mkt_ops: I think the webhook to SFDC paused for ~45m on 2026-03-12 (ops incident) — could explain missing MQLs.

maria_analytics: Confirmed: ~1.2k regs from webinar; only ~60% passed qualification vs 78% baseline. Suspect messaging mismatch in post-reg email flow. I'll run funnel by email variant.

liz_marketing: Was a new post-reg sequence used? @noah_mkt_ops

noah_mkt_ops: Yes — we rolled a new sequence for the webinar: new subject line + trimmed CTA. Flow link: https://rbw.in/flows/xyz

insights-bot: Daily ETL: lead ingestion completed (run id 20260317-21). 12,374 rows. No schema errors. :white_check_mark:

maria_analytics: SQL samples show 480 leads routed to Pardot but only 290 reached 'MQL' stage. Also noticed UTM_mismatch for ~200 regs (utm_campaign vs utm_source empty).

tom_growth: Could routing fallback be sending leads to a 'default' campaign with low-touch scoring? @maria_analytics can you check campaign mapping?

maria_analytics: On it. Quick snippet I used:
```
SELECT campaign_id, count(*)
FROM lead_routes
WHERE source='webinar'
GROUP BY campaign_id;
```

liz_marketing: Plan: Maria to produce a 24h triage (cohort by email variant + campaign mapping). Noah to confirm webhook SLA + resend missing leads. Tom to update dashboard date window and add 'qualified %' metric. Sync in 2pm standup? :calendar:

tom_growth: :thumbsup: I'll update the dashboard. Want the 'qualified %' shown as a sparkline on the weekly view.

noah_mkt_ops: I'll run a backfill for the 45m gap and confirm with ops. If backfill OK, we can reprocess the batch.

liz_marketing: Thanks team. If anyone spots an obvious attribution mismatch before the 2pm huddle, drop here. Also note this may affect next week's MQL forecast.
